criteria.description: Separates 1200x630 web and 70x50cm print geometry and gives approximate 300dpi pixel dimensions.
Explicitly blocks publication on unlicensed celebrity photo/commercial font and calls for legitimate alternatives/permissions.
Distinguishes editable layered/vector source from raster exports and says no asset was rendered.
Specifies practical responsive crop and print bleed/safe zone, typeface and Persian text QA.
Includes evidence-based final QA/handoff checklist and explicit DRAFT/BLOCKED status.
